battle.name: 第一次護法戰爭
battle.brief: 中文維基戰爭列表所列的第一次護法戰爭，由1917年北京府院之爭與張勳復辟引發，護法一方在廣州成立軍政府，並與北洋軍閥軍隊交戰。英國海軍1862年已列裝的Ironclad鐵甲艦，是重裝甲水面艦艇的重要類型，可用於海上封鎖與岸防支援。

kit.name: 鐵甲艦
kit.history: 鐵甲艦是英國皇家海軍的重裝甲水面艦艇類型，1862年已列裝，置於海軍主力序列，主要承擔遠海巡弋、海上封鎖與岸防支援任務，並參與艦隊作戰。

countries: 本戰爭是中國內部的軍政分裂，不是兩國之間的戰爭。北京方面先後有以黎元洪為總統的中央政府、段祺瑞主持的北洋討逆軍，以及控制直隸等地的直系部隊；以張作霖為首的奉系由東北進入京畿；張勳率領的辯護軍一度恢復溥儀帝制。南方則有孫文在廣州組織的護法軍政府，受雲南軍唐繼堯、龍濟光支持的護法軍，以及湖南護法軍和川軍。各方名義上多屬中華民國，實際上分別掌握不同省區的兵源、稅源與鐵路，因此紀錄時必須分清北京政府、奉系、直系、張勳辯護軍、護法軍政府與湘川部隊，不能把全部兵力記成同一支政府軍。英、日等國並未以交戰國身分參戰，外來介入主要落在軍械供應、軍事顧問與軍事合作等方面。
countriesEn: This war was an internal Chinese military-political rupture rather than a conflict between two sovereign states. On the Beijing side there were, in succession, the central government under President Li Yuanhong, the Beiyang Pacification Army commanded by Duan Qirui, and Zhili-controlled forces in Zhili and neighboring districts. The Fengtian army under Zhang Zuolin entered the Beijing region from Northeast China, while Zhang Xun’s Protection Army briefly restored Puyi to imperial power. In the south, Sun Yat-sen organized the Constitutional Protection military government at Guangzhou. Its fighting forces depended heavily on the Yunnan troops of Tang Jiyao and Long Jiguang, while Hunan’s Constitutional Protection Army and the Sichuan armies formed separate provincial contingents. Although these factions formally claimed to belong to the Republic of China, they controlled different sources of soldiers, revenue, and railways. Accounts therefore have to distinguish the Beijing government, Fengtian, Zhili, Zhang Xun’s army, the Guangzhou government, and the Hunan and Sichuan formations rather than treating every unit as one government army. Britain, Japan, and other foreign states were not belligerents, but their influence entered through weapons supplies, military advisers, and military cooperation.
people: 第一段戰局由張勳的軍事行動與段祺瑞的反制共同推動。張勳把辯護軍作為恢復帝制的武力，溥儀則是受其擁立的政治象徵；段祺瑞在天津主持討逆，利用張作霖的奉軍壓制北京內的張勳部隊。黎元洪在一九一七年七月初免去張勳內閣，但罷免本身未能解除武裝衝突。奉軍入京後，張作霖要求在京畿保留兵員與補給權，張宗昌指揮前出部隊，兩派隨即因直奉軍權與控制權交鋒。吳佩孚所指揮的直系北路軍在山海關至天津一線反攻，成為迫使段祺瑞下台的主要軍事力量；馮國璋也參與北洋將領之間的協調。南方護法軍由孫文主持政治，實際作戰依賴唐繼堯、龍濟光率領的滇軍；湖南由林修戡、譚延闓主持，川軍則以劉湘為核心，劉文輝等部亦參與軍事行動。徐世昌在一九一七年十一月接任北京政府總統，承接的是北洋內部衝突尚未完全平息的局面。
peopleEn: The opening phase was driven by the military action of Zhang Xun and the counter-mobilization organized by Duan Qirui. Zhang Xun used the Protection Army as the instrument for restoring the monarchy, while Puyi functioned as the political figurehead he installed. Duan organized resistance from Tianjin and brought Zhang Zuolin’s Fengtian troops into the campaign against Zhang Xun’s forces inside Beijing. Li Yuanhong dismissed Zhang Xun’s cabinet in early July 1917, but the dismissal did not remove the underlying armed conflict. After entering Beijing, the Fengtian army sought to retain troops and supply rights in the capital region, with Zhang Zongchang commanding forward formations; disagreements over command and control then developed into fighting between Zhili and Fengtian. The Zhili northern army commanded by Wu Peifu counterattacked along the Shanhaiguan–Tianjin axis and became the principal military force that compelled Duan Qirui to resign. Feng Guozhang also helped coordinate the Beiyang commanders. In the south, Sun Yat-sen provided political leadership, while military operations depended chiefly on the Yunnan troops of Tang Jiyao and Long Jiguang. Lin Xiuyi and Tan Yankai directed Hunan’s protection forces, and Liu Xiang was the central figure among the Sichuan contingents, with forces such as Liu Wenhui’s taking part. Xu Shichang became president of the Beijing government in November 1917, inheriting a Beiyang political and military situation whose internal conflicts had not yet been fully settled.
kits: 各軍裝備並不一致，但所用槍械均可追溯至一九一七年以前的正式列裝。奉系常見日造Type 38步槍與Type 30重機槍；雲南軍械庫有日造Type 88步槍及德造Gewehr 98步槍；部分湖南部隊使用奧造Mannlicher M1895步槍，廣東、廣西軍械庫亦見意造Carcano M91步槍。機槍包括一九一〇年正式採用的Maxim MG08及日造Type 30。炮兵使用七五毫米Krupp M1904野戰砲、Schneider-Creusot M1907野戰砲等早期型號，並有輕型野戰砲與團、營所屬砲兵分隊。步槍彈因來源不同而分為六五、六八、七九二與八毫米等規格，機槍彈另按槍管口徑發放，七五毫米炮彈則由各砲兵隊列專冊；同一部隊混用數種步槍，使備件、瞄具和彈藥分發格外繁雜。後勤依靠京奉路、錦州至承德支線、京漢路、粵漢路及株萍路作長距離運輸，末端再以馬車、驛馬和少量汽車轉運，並用野戰電話與軍用有線電報維持指揮。
kitsEn: Equipment varied considerably between the forces, but the weapons in use all trace back to formal service systems established no later than 1917. Fengtian formations commonly held Japanese Type 38 rifles and Type 30 heavy machine guns. Yunnan arsenals contained Japanese Type 88 rifles and German Gewehr 98 rifles. Some Hunan units used Austrian Mannlicher M1895 rifles, while Italian Carcano M91 rifles appeared in Guangdong and Guangxi arsenals. Machine guns included the Maxim MG08, formally adopted in 1910, and the Japanese Type 30. Artillery included early types such as the 75 mm Krupp M1904 and Schneider-Creusot M1907 field guns, supplemented by lighter field pieces and regimental or battalion gun sections. Rifle ammunition was separated into 6.5, 6.8, 7.92, and 8 mm groups according to source. Machine-gun ammunition was issued by the relevant caliber, while 75 mm shells were recorded separately by artillery units. Mixing several rifle types in one formation complicated spare parts, sights, and ammunition distribution. Long-distance supply depended on the Beijing–Mukden railway, the Jinzhou–Chengde branch, the Beijing–Hankou line, the Canton–Hankou railway, and the Zhuzhou–Pingxiang railway. At the ends of rail routes, supplies were transferred to wagons, pack animals, and a limited number of motor vehicles, while field telephones and military wire telegraph lines carried orders.
tactics: 北方戰線先後出現三種不同的作戰方法。張勳部在北京城內與近郊依託既成防線部署步兵和炮兵，以固定陣地阻擋奉軍；奉軍則利用京奉路快速調動，部隊分批到達後以騎兵擔任前哨與警戒，再由步兵和炮兵逐步壓迫守軍。直軍反攻時較倚重集中師旅、火炮支援與正面突破，先奪取山海關外側和天津方向的交通點，再向北京周邊推進；奉軍在兵力補充與彈藥接續不及直軍時，轉向承德方向撤退。南方滇軍由雲南經滇越鐵路抵達蒙自，再沿碧色寨至平棠的道路接上株萍路，兵員和糧彈受狹窄路段與轉運站限制。湘軍利用長沙一帶道路、河流與城郊陣地逐次抵抗，北方遠征軍則以京漢、粵漢鐵路輸送部隊，試圖以集中炮兵和連續步兵攻勢奪取長沙。川軍在山地道路與江運條件下防守成都方向。各線雖使用電話、旗語和傳令兵，命令仍常因前線距離、通信中斷及各部互不隸屬而延誤，形成的是火力與後勤受限的線性攻防，而非現代化聯合作戰。
tacticsEn: Three different methods characterized the northern front. Zhang Xun’s troops used fixed infantry and artillery positions inside and around Beijing to block the Fengtian attack. The Fengtian army moved rapidly by the Beijing–Mukden railway, brought its units forward in successive echelons, used cavalry for outposts and security, and then pressed the defenders with infantry and artillery. During the Zhili counteroffensive, concentrated divisions, artillery support, and frontal breakthroughs became more prominent. The Zhili forces first seized transport points beyond Shanhaiguan and toward Tianjin before driving toward the Beijing perimeter. When the Fengtian army could not keep pace in troop replacement and ammunition, it withdrew in the direction of Chengde. In the south, Yunnan troops traveled by the Yunnan–Vietnam railway to Mengzi, then used the narrow Mengzi–Bisezhai–Pingxiang road to connect with the Zhuzhou–Pingxiang railway. Their strength and supply were constrained by restricted road sections and transfer stations. Hunan troops resisted successively around Changsha, using roads, rivers, and positions outside the city, while the northern expeditionary forces used the Beijing–Hankou and Canton–Hankou railways to bring up troops and sought to seize Changsha through concentrated artillery and repeated infantry attacks. Sichuan forces defended toward Chengdu under the constraints of mountain roads and river transport. Although telephone lines, flags, and couriers were used, orders were often delayed by distance, interrupted communications, and the refusal of some formations to accept outside control. The result was a linear battle shaped by artillery and logistical limits rather than modern combined-arms warfare.
data: 廣義的護法戰爭通常分為一九一七年六月至一九一八年七月，其中一九一七年九月至十一月的直奉衝突是北方主戰段。一九一七年六月一日，張勳的辯護軍進入北京並擁立溥儀；七月三日，黎元洪免去張勳內閣；八月二十五日，奉軍在段祺瑞方面的軍事壓力下攻入北京，張勳投降，帝制政府終止。九月十日，孫文在廣州成立護法軍政府，自任大元帥，唐繼堯與龍濟光任元帥，九月中旬以後直奉兩軍在山海關外側、秦皇島、北京東南及天津外圍反覆交戰，戰線一度退向承德方向。十一月七日，段祺瑞辭去北洋討逆軍總司令等職；十一月十日，徐世昌就任北京政府總統，北方主戰段至此基本停止，奉軍退回東北但保存了主力。十二月四日，湖南宣布護法並成立軍事政府；一九一八年一月二十七日，四川護法軍政府成立；三月十三日？北方軍進入長沙的日期通常記作三月二十三日，湖南護法政府因而瓦解；六月十三日，成都被北方軍占領，川軍政府亦告崩潰。七月五日，廣州軍政府改組，第一階段的軍事高潮告一段落，但南北衝突未因此完全終止。北京政府九月曾公布十六個師、五個旅的討逆軍序列，實際在前線的師旅數、番號與戰鬥減員持續變動。現存各方傷亡數字互有矛盾，不能負責任地列出一個統一總數，只能確認戰役造成大量陣亡、負傷、被俘、逃散與裝備損失。
dataEn: The broader Constitutional Protection War is conventionally divided between June 1917 and July 1918, with the Zhili–Fengtian conflict from September to November 1917 forming its main northern phase. On 1 June 1917, Zhang Xun’s Protection Army entered Beijing and installed Puyi. On 3 July, Li Yuanhong dismissed Zhang Xun’s cabinet. On 25 August, under the military pressure organized by Duan Qirui, the Fengtian army entered Beijing, Zhang Xun surrendered, and the restored imperial government ended. On 10 September, Sun Yat-sen established the Constitutional Protection military government at Guangzhou, serving as grand marshal with Tang Jiyao and Long Jiguang as marshals. From mid-September, Zhili and Fengtian forces fought repeatedly around the outer Shanhaiguan defenses, Qinhuangdao, southeastern Beijing, and the approaches to Tianjin, with the front at times shifting back toward Chengde. On 7 November, Duan Qirui resigned as commander in chief of the Beiyang Pacification Army and from his other military offices. Xu Shichang became president of the Beijing government on 10 November, and the principal northern phase then came largely to an end; the Fengtian army withdrew to Northeast China while preserving its main force. On 4 December, Hunan declared for the Constitutional Protection movement and formed a military government. The Sichuan Constitutional Protection military government was established on 27 January 1918. The date usually given for the northern army’s entry into Changsha is 23 March, after which the Hunan protection government collapsed. Chengdu was occupied by northern troops on 13 June, and the Sichuan government likewise disintegrated. On 5 July, the Guangzhou military government was reorganized, marking the end of the first phase’s military climax without ending every conflict between north and south. In September, the Beijing government published a Pacification Army establishment of sixteen divisions and five brigades, but the divisions, brigades, and front-line strengths actually present continued to change through redeployment and combat losses. Surviving casualty figures contradict one another and cannot support a single responsible total; the campaign indisputably produced substantial deaths, wounds, captures, desertions, and equipment losses.
cause: 張勳復辟是直接導火線，卻不是戰爭唯一的根源。北京政府內部早已存在黎元洪、段祺瑞及北洋各系對軍權、內閣與議會控制權的衝突；張勳利用直系與皖系之間的矛盾，率軍進京恢復帝制，使政治鬥爭迅速變成公開戰爭。段祺瑞在天津組織討逆後，不僅要解除張勳的武裝，也企圖重新掌握中央軍權，並以消滅廣州護法軍政府、迫使各省軍隊服從北京為下一階段目標。九月北京政府解散國會並準備南征，孫文等人在廣州另立軍政府，南方因此獲得明確的政治與軍事中心。奉軍入京本為討伐張勳，卻因兵力指揮、補給來源與北京控制權與直系發生衝突，直奉戰爭遂在護法名義下展開。更深層的原因是晚清新軍被各省軍閥分割，稅收、軍械和鐵路各自控制，中央命令雖存在，地方部隊卻常依省界與派系利益決定服從、轉向或停火。
causeEn: Zhang Xun’s restoration was the immediate trigger, but it was not the sole root of the war. The Beijing government already contained conflicts among Li Yuanhong, Duan Qirui, and the Beiyang factions over military authority, cabinet power, and control of parliament. Zhang Xun exploited disagreements between the Zhili and Anhui interests by marching into Beijing and restoring the monarchy, turning a political struggle into open warfare. After organizing resistance at Tianjin, Duan Qirui sought not merely to disarm Zhang Xun but also to reassert central control and prepare a southern campaign against the Guangzhou Constitutional Protection government and the provincial forces. When the Beijing government dissolved parliament in September and prepared to move south, Sun Yat-sen and his supporters established a separate military government at Guangzhou, giving the southern movement a defined political and military center. The Fengtian army originally entered Beijing to suppress Zhang Xun, but disputes over command, supply, and control of the capital with the Zhili turned the campaign into a Zhili–Fengtian war under the banner of constitutional protection. The deeper cause was the fragmentation of the late Qing New Army among provincial military rulers. Revenue, weapons, and railways were controlled locally, so central orders existed in name, but provincial formations regularly decided whether to obey, change sides, or cease fighting according to provincial and factional interests.
impact: 戰爭首先改變了北洋權力格局。張勳的辯護軍被解散，溥儀仍居皇城但已無實際政府權力；段祺瑞雖藉討逆重返北京，卻因直奉戰敗、南方遠征未竟及北洋內部不受控而於十一月下台。吳佩孚與直系因主導反攻取得軍事聲望，張作霖則保留東北根據地、整建完畢的奉軍和在京畿的發言能力，兩個集團都沒有被徹底消滅。南方護法軍政府得以維持廣州與廣西，並一度吸引湖南、四川成立地方護法政府；但北軍占據長沙與成都，使滇軍、湘軍和川軍原有的區域聯合受到重挫。軍事制度方面，鐵路運輸線、兵站位置、電報與電話節線、炮兵集中及多口徑彈藥管理，直接決定各次進攻能持續多久。這場戰爭也證明，只有北京一紙命令不足以約束省軍，沒有統一財政、鐵路和補給的中央軍，即使取得局部戰役也難以完成全國軍事統一。
impactEn: The war first transformed the balance of Beiyang power. Zhang Xun’s Protection Army was dissolved, and Puyi remained in the imperial palace without actual governmental power. Duan Qirui returned to Beijing through the anti-restoration campaign, but military defeat by the Zhili and Fengtian, the unfinished southern expedition, and his inability to control the Beiyang factions forced his resignation in November. Wu Peifu and the Zhili gained military prestige by leading the counteroffensive, while Zhang Zuolin retained his Manchurian base, an intact Fengtian army, and influence around Beijing. Neither northern group was eliminated. In the south, the Constitutional Protection government maintained itself in Guangzhou and Guangxi and briefly drew Hunan and Sichuan into forming local protection governments. The northern occupation of Changsha and Chengdu, however, severely damaged the regional alignment among the Yunnan, Hunan, and Sichuan forces. Across the armed forces, railway lines, depots, telegraph and telephone connections, artillery concentration, and ammunition management determined how long each offensive could be sustained. The conflict also demonstrated that a Beijing order could not by itself control provincial armies. Without centralized finance, railways, and supply, the Beijing forces could win local battles without completing military unification.
result: 第一階段的結果可分別在北方與南方判定。北方方面，張勳復辟和辯護軍失敗，溥儀沒有恢復實際統治；段祺瑞於一九一七年十一月七日辭職，徐世昌在十日接任總統。直軍在山海關、北京東南與天津方向的反攻迫使奉軍北撤，但奉軍並未遭到決定性殲滅，張作霖仍控制東北並保有完整兵團，吳佩孚所代表的直系則成為北京中央最主要的軍事力量，因此直奉之間沒有產生真正的勝者。南方方面，北方遠征軍於一九一八年占領長沙並瓦解湖南護法政府，六月占領成都、迫使川軍政府崩潰；然而廣州護法軍政府未被消滅，仍保有廣東與廣西，並在七月五日完成改組。由此看，第一階段結束時，南北在華北的控制權重新分配，廣東、廣西仍由護法方面掌握，湖南與四川回到北京政府的軍事控制之下，而護法問題並未因任何一場戰役而解決。戰後衝突轉入新的南北對峙，這才是第一次護法戰爭留下的實際終局；由於傷亡紀錄互相衝突，不宜宣稱任何精確總數。
resultEn: The results of the first phase can be assessed separately in the north and south. In the north, Zhang Xun’s restoration and Protection Army failed, and Puyi did not recover actual rule. Duan Qirui resigned on 7 November 1917, and Xu Shichang took office as president on 10 November. The Zhili counteroffensive around Shanhaiguan, southeastern Beijing, and Tianjin forced the Fengtian army north, but the Fengtian were not decisively destroyed. Zhang Zuolin retained control of Northeast China and an intact army, while the Zhili represented by Wu Peifu became the strongest military force within the Beijing government. Neither side in the Zhili–Fengtian struggle achieved a true victory. In the south, the northern expeditionary army occupied Changsha in 1918 and dismantled the Hunan protection government, then took Chengdu in June and forced the Sichuan protection government to collapse. The Guangzhou Constitutional Protection government was not destroyed, however. It retained Guangdong and Guangxi and completed a reorganization on 5 July. At the end of the first phase, control in North China had been redistributed, Guangdong and Guangxi remained under the Constitutional Protection side, and Hunan and Sichuan had returned to Beijing military control. The constitutional dispute itself was therefore not settled by any single battle. Renewed north–south confrontation became the practical outcome of the First Constitutional Protection War, and the contradictory casualty records make any precise aggregate total untenable.
